summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-discretionary share buyback programme for June 9–26, 2026, with a £200 million spend, part of a £2.25 billion 2026 buyback plan. Shares purchased will be held in treasury under prior shareholder authority (max 163M shares). ABN AMRO executes instructions independently. This is an open-market issuer return of capital. Watch execution pace and any future capital return updates.
